name: Long Cốc
description: Famous tea hills, extremely popular among photographers for Milky Way and sunrise shots.

name: Phan Rang - Tháp Chàm
description: Dry coastal area with clear skies and incredible rock formations at Hang Rái for astrophotography.

name: Gia Nghĩa
description: High altitude, low light pollution, perfect for deep sky and Milky Way.

name: Mũi Dinh
description: Lighthouse and desert-like dunes, very dark skies.

name: Vịnh Hạ Long
description: Sheltered by 1,600 limestone islands — glassy mirror water at dawn, world-class seascapes.

name: Vịnh Lan Hạ
description: Quieter than Hạ Long, perfectly sheltered for mirror-flat water and kayaking.

name: Côn Đảo (Bãi Đầm Trầu)
description: Crystal-clear sheltered bay, often glassy calm — perfect mirror sea photography.

name: Bãi Sao (Phú Quốc)
description: Famous powdery white sand, sheltered western beach with famously calm clear water.

name: Vịnh Vĩnh Hy
description: Deep sheltered bay between mountains, often windless with mirror-flat turquoise water.

name: Đầm Ô Loan
description: Peaceful lagoon near Tuy Hòa, famous for sunset mirror reflections over still water.

name: Bãi Dài (Cam Ranh)
description: Long sheltered bay stretching 13km with consistently calm, mirror-like water.

name: Hồ Cốc
description: Secluded beach with calm waters, backed by forest — mirror conditions in mornings.

name: Đầm Nha Phu
description: Shallow lagoon north of Nha Trang, extremely sheltered — glass water almost year-round.

name: Bãi Dứa (Nha Trang)
description: Small sheltered cove on Hòn Tre island, famously calm and clear — mirror sea at sunrise.

name: Biển Vô Cực (Thái Bình)
description: Endless flat beach at low tide — famous mirror-like reflection stretching to the horizon.

name: Biển Vô Cực (Mỹ Đức)
description: Tidal flat beach with immense mirror reflections — photographers' paradise at dawn and dusk.
